  [1] File: workflow-templates/validation-harness/python-mongo-flask/docker-compose.test.yml.j2
      Problem: The Dockerfile path is relative to the build context (..), but the renderer places all rendered files (including the Dockerfile and the compose file) into a single flat directory (defaulting to `validation/`).; When `docker compose` runs from within the output directory, it resolves `../validation/Dockerfile.app`. Since the Dockerfile is actually at `./Dockerfile.app` within that same directory, the build will fail with "unable to prepare context: path 'validation/Dockerfile.app' not found".

There is no `validation/` subdirectory at that level. The command will fail with "file validation/docker-compose.test.yml not found".
